sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:47504
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 54747 of 2023

Applicant :- Vijay Pal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Upendra Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
On 9.1.2024 notice was issued to the informant.
As per office report dated 29.1.2024 notice has been served to the informant.
2. Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

3. Heard Sri Upendra Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S. B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.
4. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
196 of 2023, under Sections 457, 363, 376(3), 323, 506 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Deyuriya Kalan, District Pilibhit, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
5. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his nephew Sanjeev and sister Khushboo and according to the FIR in the intervening night of 21/22.8.2023 applicant alongwith co-accused entered in the house of the informant and on the point of country-made pistol abducted Vijay Pal vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168374750/
1 the daughter of the informant aged about 15 years.
6.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and only due to enmity, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.
7.

He further submitted that in the statement recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C. victim categorically stated that no rape was committed and only stated that applicant alongwith his two associates has forcibly taken her out of the village on the point of pistol but when her statement was recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. then she started making allegation of rape and this fact clearly suggests that subsequently under the pressure of her parents, victim started making false allegation of rape.
8.

He further submitted that actually the parents and other family members of the victim wanted to perform her marriage with the applicant but as family members of the applicant were not ready,
therefore, a false story has been cooked up by the informant and implicated the applicant and his family members in the present.
9. He further submitted that the co-accused Sanjeev and Khushboo are the close relatives of the applicant 10.
He further submitted that applicant is not having any previous criminal history to his credit and he is in jail since 3.9.2023.

11. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that victim in her statement recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. categorically stated that applicant committed rape upon her and she is hardly 15 years old girl but could not dispute the fact that in her statement recorded u/s 161 Cr.P.C. victim categorically stated that no rape was committed upon her.

12. He, however, further submitted that applicant is also having criminal history of one another case of under sections 323, 325, 504 IPC but fairly conceded that this case is of the year 2018 and applicant is on bail in that case.
13. I have heard learned counsel for both the sides and perused the record of the case.

14. However, victim appears to be 15 years old girl at the time of alleged incident and she made allegation of rape against the applicant in her statement recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. but when earlier her statement was recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C. then she categorically stated that no rape was committed upon her, therefore, as far as allegation of rape is concerned, there are material contradictions in both the statements of the victim recorded under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
15.
However, applicant is also having criminal history of one another case but that case relates to minor offences and in that case applicant is on bail and that case is of the year 2018.
Further, in the present matter applicant is in jail since September, 2023.

2 16.

sentences.text:
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
17. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

18. Let the applicant-Vijay Pal be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
19. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

20. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
